==Merge notices==
Why were the merge notices removed? Is there a better way to let everyone know about Concord's content? --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 22:42, 16 Nov 2005 (UTC)

On further reflection (their removal sort of caught me by surprise), I have just rolled back the two "removed merge notice" edits that were still '''(top)''', and will worry about the others later.  Merge '''''suggestions''''' (they are in fact more of a ''suggestion'' than a ''notice'') are meant to be '''''discussed''''' before the tag is removed.  As an absolute minimium, a reason should be given when removing a merge tag, so the person who suggested the merge has something to go on and isn't left quite so slack-jawed... --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 00:23, 17 Nov 2005 (UTC)
